description: Sidecar, the second window (spec 2026-11-13-sidecar-design.md): its events and the window calls its own title bar makes, nothing else. Its page boots no cockpit; opening an agent goes through sidecar:act to the main window. The S button and the pin button are the host command sidecar_form, not window calls (an app command needs no entry here), so set-position and set-always-on-top are not granted; inner-size and set-size stay for the CDP scenario's own window calls; internal-toggle-maximize is the double click on the drag region; is-maximized and is-fullscreen tell the page whether Windows 11 rounds the window's corners, which its alert frame follows.
